records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE standalone planetary building-layer sprite, square transparent PNG, approximately 1024 x 1024.
Purpose: reusable architecture above a SEPARATE biome ground layer. Produce BUILDING ONLY, not a diorama. Genuine zero-alpha transparency around the building; preserve translucent soft shadow. No baked soil, gravel apron, moss, grass, rocks around the site, concrete base tile, raised platform, roads, path, border or landscape. Small integral ramps/steps/support feet belonging to the structure are allowed.
Style: the approved new Boreal/Temperate structures, grounded near-future frontier engineering. Soft semi-realistic environmental 3D rendering, matte weathered steel, subdued grey/slate/forest-green panels, restrained amber/cyan service lights. Large readable forms, no ink outlines, no cel shading, plastic gloss, extreme contrast, excessive greebles or neon. No text, logos, Authority branding, numerals, UI, people, vehicles or spacecraft.
Camera and lighting: elevated front-left three-quarter view about 55 degrees above the ground plane; more roof than wall, mild perspective; front and right walls visible. Soft upper-left daylight, neutral/cool fill and semi-transparent soft lower-right cast/contact shadow attached to the feet.
Framing/alignment (match the approved Agroplex tiers 1-3 exactly): solid building width about94% of the canvas (x about3–97%), centred at x=50%. Its near/front foot, the lowest solid point, at y about88%. Same ground footprint as tier3: the low greenhouse bays stay at ground level and all new height grows upward from them. Keep at least3% transparent margin above the tallest point; if a tower would rise higher, make it slimmer or lower, never shrink the footprint, never crop. At1024 square this means solid building spans approximately x31–993, front foot at y901, tallest solid feature below y31. Prioritize that fixed bay footprint and camera over making the building look taller.
Output exactly one structure, no tier lineup/contact sheet.
Input image1 is the approved Agroplex tier3. Keep its architecture, materials, grey-green ribs, glazing, visible crop rows, nutrient tanks and finish; this is the same building family upgraded, not a new design. Input image2, when attached, is the tier just below this one; grow from it.
Family identity: low glazed crop-production bays with grey-green ribs, visible green crop rows, compact packing/control rooms and squat nutrient tanks. Recognizable industrial greenhouse silhouette. Crops grow only under glass: no planted roofs, roof gardens, trees or stepped garden terraces (those belong to a different building).
Tier family progression for context (do NOT draw a lineup): 1: two low attached greenhouse bays; 2: two reinforced glazed bays with a taller rear packing room; 3: three compact growing bays with a raised climate core; 4: the three bays carry a second glazed gallery deck; 5: a three-deck glass growing hall around a central service core; 6: a vertical-farm tower of stacked glazed crop decks rising from the same bays, same compact site.
Output: exactly the requested tier alone, genuine transparent RGBA PNG.
Subject: AGROPLEX — TIER 4 of 6.
This tier specifically: the three glazed growing bays of tier3 now carry a second glazed gallery deck along their full length, reached by an external stair and lift tower, with a larger nutrient tank.
Keep all three original front bay entrances and their small integral ramps at ground level in the same positions and at the same image scale. Add a second enclosed GLASS GROWING DECK along the complete length of each bay, with readable crop rows on both decks, grey-green structural ribs and practical horizontal deck supports. The external stair and lift tower are compact attachments within the existing overall site outline. The second deck must be visibly a structural upgrade of these same three greenhouse bays, not a separate building or an outdoor terrace. Keep the nutrient tank broad and squat.
records.postprocessing: Normalized to1024×1024 with solid width94%, centered horizontally and front foot88%. The footprint is not reduced to accommodate height; overly tall artwork is rejected for revision.

Shorten ONLY the tower's floor-to-floor spacing by about25%, and lower its rooftop climate machinery. Retain exactly FIVE stacked enclosed glass crop decks, with grey-green horizontal ribs and green crop rows visibly growing on every deck. The tower stays a clearly taller vertical-farm volume rising behind the original low greenhouse bays, but its storeys are compact and practical, with much less wasted vertical space. Maintain the familiar ducts, low rooftop climate plant, grey-green metal and transparent growing decks. Make the two nutrient tanks a matched pair of broad, squat tanks beside the same base.

CRITICAL: DO NOT SHRINK THE WHOLE BUILDING OR ITS GROUND FOOTPRINT. Preserve the original size and length of all three low barrel-vaulted growing bays, their front entrances and small ramps. Fit by reducing the upper tower's deck heights and rooftop equipment, never by shrinking the low-bay footprint or cropping.

Keep the same elevated front-left three-quarter camera, approximately55° downward, front and right walls visible. Crops ONLY under glass; no roof gardens, trees, terraces or housing.

Genuine zero-alpha transparency around the complete building with soft translucent lower-right contact shadow. Building only: no soil, gravel, rocks, grass, external planted areas, concrete tile, raised base, roads, paths, landscape, people, vehicles, spacecraft, text, labels, logos or watermark. Deliver exactly one complete square RGBA PNG, approximately1024×1024.
